description: Pass on your no to the card your Switch Agent is waiting on (pending_action in an ask_switch_agent answer). The step does not run and nothing is charged for it; the agent answers with what it can do instead. This tool only declines; a yes is your own tap in Switch.

conversation_id.description: The conversation whose card you said no to.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the agent's next words (5 to 55, default 45).

name: decline_switch_agent_action
title: Decline Switch Agent Action
